title: 第291章市里来的电报
slug: 临时加彩礼转头另娶绝美女知青
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

任何年代结婚，进宅都是大喜事儿。

冯娜既然把陈卫东当成了亲弟弟走动了，人家进宅自己必须得到场。

冯娜便笑着冲陈卫东道：“行，放心吧，姐到时候肯定会过去的。”

买完东西，陈卫东没有在供销社这边多耽误，去了纺织厂。

他没有找曹斌，而是找了二姐。

陈卫东将带来的野猪肉带给了陈红梅，并且叮嘱二姐给曹斌也送去一吊。

听到陈卫东的叮嘱，陈红梅便笑着道：“行，卫东，姐知道了，会给曹厂长送过去的。”

“嗯，姐，那我先回去了。今年家里上梁，我来县里供销社买了东西，得赶紧送回去。”

一听到娘家盖的房子要上梁了，陈红梅也很激动和期待。

“卫东，这么快就要上梁了？”

“是啊，姐，工人们都很努力，盖得快，不然正常速度现在肯定还没上梁。”

陈红梅知道，弟弟是个大方厚道的人。

他给的工钱多，还能让工人们吃上肉，人家干活儿能不卖力吗？

陈红梅笑着道：“那是你对他们好，他们才能努力盖房子。

可惜了，厂子这两天很忙，不然咱家上梁我还想着能回去凑凑热闹呢。”

见二姐这么说，陈卫东便顺道关心了一句：“二姐，这两天厂子很忙吗？”

“嗯，忙，听厂子的老员工说，最近新出的布料卖得特别好，所以订单量比较多，咱们厂子只能加班搞生产了。”

陈卫东听到了二姐的解释，便想到了纺织厂新出的这批布料应该是他设计的。

既然纺织厂这边能卖的不错，这是大好事儿。

纺织厂的效益越高，回头二姐、二姐夫转正的希望也就越大。

看到未来一点点地在变好，这日子也越发的让人觉得有盼头，有希望了。

“二姐，没事儿，等咱家办暖屋酒你再回去，现在工作要紧。”

听到陈卫东的安慰，陈红梅重重地点头：“嗯，二姐也是这么想的。

眼下最重要的事情就是做好工作，表现好了，我和你二姐夫才能有机会早点转正。”

转正后的工资直接翻倍，而且各项待遇都能更好。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Getting married and moving into a house at any age is a joyful event.

Since Feng Na regards Chen Weidong as her biological brother, she must be present when others enter the house.

Feng Na then smiled and said to Chen Weidong: "Okay, don't worry, I will definitely get there when the time comes."

After shopping, Chen Weidong went to the textile factory without spending any more time at the supply and marketing cooperative.

He didn't find Cao Bin, but his second sister.

Chen Weidong brought the wild boar meat to Chen Hongmei, and asked his second sister to give Cao Bin one as well.

Hearing Chen Weidong's instructions, Chen Hongmei smiled and said: "Okay, Weidong, if I know, I will send it to Director Cao."

"Well, sister, I'll go back first. This year my family is going to have a flood, so I came to the county supply and marketing cooperative to buy something, and I have to send it back quickly."

When she heard that the house built by her parents was going to be built, Chen Hongmei was very excited and looking forward to it.

"Weidong, are you going to go to bed so soon?"

"Yes, sister, the workers are working very hard and building the building quickly, otherwise the normal speed would not have reached the beam by now."

Chen Hongmei knows that her younger brother is a generous and kind person.

He pays a lot of wages and allows the workers to eat meat. How can they not work hard?

Chen Hongmei smiled and said: "That's because you are good to them, so they can work hard to build a house.

It's a pity that the factory has been very busy these two days, otherwise I would have thought that I could go back and join in the fun."

Seeing what the second sister said, Chen Weidong asked with concern: "Second sister, is the factory very busy these two days?"

"Well, I'm busy. I heard from the old employees of the factory that the newly released fabrics have been selling very well recently, so there are a lot of orders. Our factory can only work overtime for production."

After hearing his second sister's explanation, Chen Weidong thought that the new batch of fabrics produced by the textile factory should be designed by him.

Since the textile factory can sell well, this is a good thing.

The higher the efficiency of the textile factory, the greater the hope that the second sister and second brother-in-law will become regular workers.

Seeing that the future is getting better little by little, these days are becoming more and more promising and hopeful.

"Second sister, it's okay. You can go back after our family has a warm house party. Work is important now."

Hearing Chen Weidong's comfort, Chen Hongmei nodded heavily: "Well, the second sister thinks so too.

The most important thing right now is to do a good job and perform well, so that your second brother-in-law and I can have the opportunity to become full-time employees as soon as possible."

After becoming a regular employee, the salary will be doubled directly, and all benefits will be better.
